global_rules.primary_metric: Pearson r² separately per case; keep signed Pearson r and separate R²
global_rules.tie_policy: truth/prediction ascending; equal values by lower segment_id

stage_2_thermal_contract.goal: Fix sparse-grid thermal scenario and separate local vs cumulative temperature.
stage_2_thermal_contract.selection: No temperature parameter tuning; fix contract before model comparison.

stage_3_s1_known_pipe.folds: identical fixed block masks per scheme; LOPO retained separately
stage_3_s1_known_pipe.goal: Test same-pipe spatial signal at fixed block schemes and compare global vs local Ridge.
stage_3_s1_known_pipe.selection_filter: promising_S1 only if on both 200m/50m and 500m/100m schemes MAE < S1A, signed r > 0, and Pearson r / top10 recall not worse than S1A; then compare with affine; max 2 S1 challengers.
stage_3_s1_known_pipe.temporal_limit: Training has one dt=3.78370979; production dt=1.404517/5.188227; time law not identifiable from OOF.

constraints: no tuning of U/cp/Tground/Arrhenius on one environment
save raw/centered/clipped predictions and clipping count

fixed_parameters.centering: full-grid per id/cutoff, length-weighted and arithmetic-mean reported

stage_4_s2_centered.goal: Separate physics level from a full-grid-centered spatial residual.

stage_5_external_evaluation.goal: Freeze candidates and prepare one-shot external evaluation without fit.
stage_5_external_evaluation.if_labels_arrive: mark as used development data, require new independent check
stage_5_external_evaluation.if_only_scores: compare frozen candidates; no segment-level diagnosis
stage_5_external_evaluation.input_truth_policy: truth separate from inference features; no fit; no overwrite

stage_6_handoff.goal: Final frozen package, mentor questions and handoff.
